title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 04:00 UTC on 2 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 2 日 04:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.00 (1Z) at 04:00 UTC on 2 October 2026. The 04:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 04:59; hour-start 1.00/1Z, hour-end 1.00/1Z). Last-180 maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-10-02T02:56:00Z; label 1Z). Published-window maximum is 1.67 (first at 2026-10-01T23:57:00Z; label 2M). Window start 2026-10-01T23:57:00Z (359 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 05:00 UTC on 2 October 2026 hour is still incomplete (56 samples through 05:55).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (04:00 UTC on 2 October 2026). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
